title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero
overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

title: Paradise Lost
overview: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

title: Flying Cows
overview: In the 1990s, a dairy farm was working on a special milk formula that could heal wounds and make people look younger. To get out of poverty, a group of workers planned to steal it, but everything changed when their leader, Trau, started to fall for the person who created the formula.

title: Those Days With Mom
overview: While some children spend their childhood fighting for love, some mothers love in ways their children never understand. Growing up in the shadow of her mother's apparent favoritism for her older brother, May turned her quiet hurt into constant resentment. A sudden crisis finally forces her to look back, only to realize the bitter truth: she hadn't been unloved—she had simply spent her life misinterpreting her mother's heart. Shedding light on the unseen pain of the "invisible child," NGAY CON CON ME" delivers a deeply moving story of love, forgiveness, and the bonds we must cherish before it's too late.

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: Arnie & Barney
overview: A platoon of ants set out to save their community in the midst of a severe drought, but the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney – who are not cut out for heroics – decide to tackle the problem themselves. Their bumbling efforts lead them to uncover a shady water racket and team up with a secretive superhero mosquito. In a series of comical mishaps, they inadvertently save the meadow and become the most unlikely heroes of all.

title: The Little Mammoth
overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

title: The Happiest Cell
overview: Phuc (Tuan Tran), once a gentle and kind-hearted teacher, became a murderer—and ended up in prison—in a desperate attempt to save his younger sister (Sally Hong Anh). Life behind bars was grueling, yet Phuc endured it with patience, hoping for an early release. Thanks to his innate goodness, he gradually influenced Tu (Ma Ran Do)—a strictly principled prison guard—and his fellow inmates, fostering positive change, harmony, and mutual empathy among them. While this "most unique lesson" was unfolding within the prison walls, Phuc’s sister was facing a challenging life on the outside without her brother by her side. Meanwhile, the notorious inmate Long (Luong The Thanh) was constantly lurking, waiting for the right moment to exact revenge on Phuc.

title: A Man of His Time
overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: Focker In-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

title: Hexed
overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

title: You, Like a Star
overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

title: Red Woman
overview: MẸ MÌN, a mysterious figure, has the power to grant people’s wishes—but every wish comes with a price.

title: You Can See Everything
overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
